question: What machine learning and deep learning methods are used for RQE?

evidence: The choice of two methods for our empirical study is motivated by the best performance achieved by Logistic Regression in question-question similarity at SemEval 2017 (best system BIBREF37 and second best system BIBREF38 ), and the high performance achieved by neural networks on larger datasets such as SNLI BIBREF13 , BIBREF39 , BIBREF40 , BIBREF41 . We first define the RQE task, then present the two approaches, and evaluate their performance on five different datasets.

title: A Question-Entailment Approach to Question Answering
answer_short: Logistic Regression, Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), Long Short Term Memory cells (LSTMs), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), and a neural network adapted from Bowman et al. with three 600d ReLU layers.
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents mention multiple machine learning and deep learning methods used for RQE. Text 3 lists Logistic Regression, RNNs, LSTMs, and CNNs as approaches tested in SemEval tasks. Text 5 describes a deep learning model adapted from Bowman et al., which uses RNNs and ReLU layers. Text 10 also references these methods in the context of question similarity and entailment. These methods are explicitly cited as being used for RQE in the medical domain.
